description:
Return the schema for an element type's type_data, as TypeScript declarations. Call this before add_elements / update_elements when you don't already know the field shape for the element_type you're placing.

By default it is compact: every field with its type and a one-line note, plus the keyframable list. Ask about specific properties with `fields: ['background_setting']` or `query: 'pill background'` — those come back with their full notes, default and an example; `detail: 'full'` returns everything, including the keyframe rules. Inside run_script it is a function like any tool: get_element_schema({element_type: 'text', query: 'line height'}) looks a property up mid-script.

Fields are listed in camelCase, the names get_clip returns. Where the tool descriptions write one in snake_case (font_setting, animation_setting), the field says so — `(= font_setting)` on fontSetting — and either spelling is accepted.

Pass element_type='group' for the GROUP surface instead — what a group is, how its pivot works, and the nine properties it can animate.

detail.description: 'compact' (default): names, types and one-line notes. 'full': every field's full notes, nested docs and the keyframe rules.

element_type.description: One of: text, callout, rectangle, arrow, blur, spotlight, zoom, image, video, animation, avatar, group

fields.description: Return only these fields, with their full notes, default and an example — text is 15KB whole, ~300 bytes for two.

format.description: Defaults to 'declarations' — TypeScript-style, which is the better READ. Inside run_script it defaults to 'json' instead, because a script indexes into the structure and the declaration text would arrive newline-escaped. Set it explicitly to override either default.

mode.description: 'add' returns required + optional fields; 'update' returns all-optional.

query.description: Words describing the property you want ('pill background', 'corner radius', 'line height'): returns the best-matching fields (up to 5) as `fields` would.

name: get_element_schema
title: Get element schema
